hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A prefix is valid if the count of vowels strictly exceeds the count of consonants.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Maintain running vowel and consonant counts as you expand the prefix character by character.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Increment match counter whenever the vowel count is strictly greater than the consonant count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulates character category frequencies.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning each prefix from scratch scales quadratically.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains running counters with scalar variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains running vowel/consonant tally in linear time.
